produced_by: independent Orca Claude Code review session, separate worktree from the implementer

denominator.note: the 10 image + 6 video denominators stated in reports/v0-s3/preparation-05/stage-packet-preparation-c.md are kept exactly; no candidate outside the frozen child was substituted and no slot was left empty

criteria: obligation coverage across the five MS04 dimensions 人物 / 场景 / 动作 / 证据一致性 / 未知-局限
category and style spread (western wedding studio, Chinese traditional wedding, night street, city night, interior, interface/document capture)
motion complexity for the video slots (shot count, subject count, camera distance change, scene change)
near-duplicate visual exclusion, judged from the observed previews
explicitly_not_used: no model or project success rate was used: the preparation run performed 0 model actions, so no result exists and none was consulted
no project analysis output, expected answer, human draft or LVW result was read or used
no eligibility count was treated as semantic quality
selection_basis.final_freeze_owner: root (Codex). This proposal does not freeze the set and does not replace any human signature.

proposed_images.unique_contribution: two-person wedding close-up with a legible English caption ("Live in your eyes") over a translucent light-streak effect; the only selected item that combines 2 subjects, a readable in-image text overlay and an added post-production effect

stacked two-panel comparison in which the small difference between the panels is a discrete prop action (a hand lifting a pale card from a wooden box); exercises 证据一致性 against a near-identical second panel
the only selected item with a large multi-person stage group; exercises 人物 counting under a crowd and a raised-arm pose, with a nested photo-inside-photo structure
wide-angle / fisheye-distorted night selfie as a single clear subject; the only selected item exercising lens distortion and dark low-light with coloured practicals

media-player screenshot whose main content is a single clear subject making a two-finger gesture in front of a green backdrop; exercises the player-chrome / overlay-text dimension together with an unambiguous 动作 cue
two subjects with the second one in extreme foreground, cropped and defocused; the only selected item that exercises occlusion and foreground/background subject separation

a dark-themed application page with large legible Chinese headings ("H3 身份参考矩阵", "推荐母版") plus an embedded player frame; the only selected item whose primary content is interface and text rather than a natural scene, and the strongest probe for the 未知/局限 dimension (the page's own claims must not be reported as facts)
Chinese traditional bridal portrait with the red double-happiness papercut backdrop; provides the eastern-wedding style contrast against the western studio and city items

busy night city street with a large lit building, signage and many background pedestrians; the only selected item whose 场景 dimension is an urban environment rather than a studio, and which stresses that background signage and small figures must not be hallucinated

over-the-shoulder mirror composition in which one person appears twice; the only selected item that forces a correct person count in the presence of a reflection, with a strong warm/cool split lighting contrast

proposed_videos.unique_contribution: the highest motion and cut complexity in the batch: 30 s, two recurring subjects, a night rain exterior that changes to a warm cafe interior between the sampled frames, and a prop state change (umbrella outdoors, cups at the table). Exercises shot detection, subject counting and scene change in one clip.

22 s with at least four distinct camera setups and a spatial state change (the bride is seated inside the car in f02 and standing outside it in f03), up to three subjects and a clear object (envelope, corsage). The second highest cut complexity in the batch and the only clip with an interior vehicle view.

three subjects in one frame with a foreground figure seen from behind, plus a clean two-step action sequence: the gowned woman turns her head back (f01 to f02) and the waiting man's expression changes to a broad smile (f02 to f04). The only selected clip whose action cue is a head turn plus an expression change on two different people.

the shortest clip in the batch, a single subject with a slow profile-to-front turn, soft overcast daylight, shallow depth of field and dense white floral scenery. It is the only selected clip that carries a soft-light bridal portrait style rather than a night or hard-light scene.

low camera angle with the same costume across the four sampled frames, a large legible door text ("901 ROOM") and a green "901" indicator. It is the only selected clip with strong in-frame text to read, and the only one shot from a pronounced low angle.

the only portrait-orientation clip in the batch and the only long-form single-subject indoor clip; the only selected item whose action cue is a hand gesture entering the frame (a two-finger sign in f04).

near_duplicate_and_exclusion_record.method: visual comparison of the observed previews only; no content hash, model output or project result was used to decide duplication

image_exclusions.reason: highest visual similarity in the batch: same setup, same framing, same pose as C18, differing only by the floral cluster added to the bodice. C18 is retained.
a tighter crop of the same night-selfie subject seen in C07; redundant with the retained C07.
same night-selfie subject family as C07 and no readable text of its own; redundant.
same night-selfie subject family as C07 with a near-identical framing; redundant.
same night-selfie subject family as C07; redundant.
a 7-panel collage of one night-selfie subject; internally self-repetitive and adds no coverage beyond C07.
a static document-frame portrait with a necklace; the weakest of the remaining candidates on 人物 / 动作 / 场景 and it duplicates the interface-capture role already covered by C10 and C13.
an 8-panel timeline built from the very clip proposed as video C24 (视频-3.mp4); selecting both would double-count one source.
a frame taken from the very clip proposed as video C24 (视频-3.mp4, the in-frame caption reads the same file name and the timestamp 12.354 s); double-counting.

a detail crop with no identifiable face, gaze or body posture; with no observable subject the 人物 and 动作 dimensions cannot be scored, so a >= 8/10 five-dimension result is not reachable. Retained as a named alternate if a deliberately ambiguous slot is wanted.

video_exclusions.reason: its first sampled frame is visually near-identical to the first sampled frame of C31 (the same wide setup of the tuxedoed figure holding the envelope beside the black sedan under the porte-cochere). C31 is retained.
its framing corresponds closely to the fourth sampled frame of C31 (the same close-up of the tuxedoed figure with the envelope at his chest). C31 is retained.
its sampled frames are visually near-identical to the first sampled frame of C23 (same wardrobe, same bus shelter, same wet night street). C23 is retained.
same production and same second character (camel coat, dark red scarf) as C23, on the same wet night street; redundant once C23 is selected.

a night outdoor single-subject selfie; its role (night ambience, hand-to-hair gesture) is already carried by C23's exterior segment and by C27's gesture, and its subject family duplicates the images already excluded as redundant. Named alternate if a 1920x1080 night single-subject slot is preferred over the portrait C24.

a low-motion interior clip with the subject reading a phone; it would have been the static / near-ambiguous slot, but it carries a persistent third-party source watermark ("sifangds.com") whose provenance and licensing are unknown. It is named as the designated alternate for a static slot and its watermark must be cleared by root before it is used. No other source was substituted.

near_duplicate_and_exclusion_record.residual_risk: C27 and C31 come from the same production and the same cast, and C27's setup does not appear among C31's four sampled frames. Because C31 is 22 s long and only 4 frames were sampled, C27 may in fact be inside the unobserved middle of C31. This cannot be confirmed from four frames, so the proposal retains a residual overlap risk between the two retained clips.

coverage_gaps_declared: No portrait-orientation video is in the 6-video proposal: C24 (720x960) is proposed, and if root prefers a landscape-only set, C24 must give way to a landscape clip. This is a coordinator decision.
The 6-video proposal contains no deliberately static or near-ambiguous slot. C30 is the closest eligible item but carries a third-party watermark that must be cleared first.
No retained video contains a crowd, a moving vehicle in motion, an animal, a sports scene or a strong-text signage shot other than the single "901 ROOM" door in C32.

The 12 available videos come from only four production clusters (two of them account for 7 of the 12). After near-duplicate exclusion the 6-video set still spans only about four filming locations and two lighting conditions.
The 10-image proposal keeps 4 items from the h3_identity_reference_matrix production batch, so the image set leans on a single batch more than the corpus as a whole.

No claim is made that these 16 items satisfy every category obligation of the wider corpus. The fixed 10 + 6 denominators and the >= 8/10, >= 5/6 and key-hallucination-0 thresholds from the stage packet are unchanged, but the breadth of the wider testSource corpus is NOT represented by these 16 items.
not_claimed: this proposal does not freeze the quality set; root freezes the selection and the specification
this proposal does not replace, anticipate or substitute for a human signature
eligibility of these candidates means only that they were decodable and inside the frozen child; it does not mean semantic quality passes
no LVW result, model score, project analysis output or expected answer was read or inferred
